guideSummary.surfnerd: Arugam Bay, known to regulars as A-Bay, is a long right-hand point that peels around the southern corner of the bay over a mix of boulders and sand. The rights run for hundreds of meters, bending to follow the beach and slowly losing size as they go. They open with a hollow section before walling up into shoulders that stay more playful than powerful, so it's an easy wave to link into long, cruisy rides.
